A '''planet''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], near the border of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] territory. The [[Planet/Legends|world]] was conquered by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], before the [[Battle of Vanquo]].
